description: This file contains functions and logic for managing session updates, including persisting session entries, emitting lifecycle hooks, ensuring skill snapshots, and handling session file paths within a session management system.

methods.name: persistSessionEntryUpdate
methods.description: Updates a session entry in the session store and optionally persists it to a file.

methods.name: emitCompactionSessionLifecycleHooks
methods.description: Emits hooks related to session end and start during session compaction.

methods.name: ensureSkillSnapshot
methods.description: Ensures that a session has an up-to-date skill snapshot, optionally building and persisting it.

methods.name: incrementCompactionCount
methods.description: Increments the session's compaction count and optionally updates session ID and tokens.

methods.name: resolveCompactionSessionFile
methods.description: Resolves the session file path for a session after compaction, based on session ID changes.

methods.name: canonicalizeAbsoluteSessionFilePath
methods.description: Resolves and canonicalizes an absolute session file path.

methods.name: rewriteSessionFileForNewSessionId
methods.description: Rewrites the session file path to reflect a new session ID, handling various filename formats.
